title: .config/ianf-dora.toml, version 1
description: What a repository counts as production, for dora-tools, which reads the copy committed on the code host's default branch. See R1 in dora-tools' docs/requirements.md.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

production.description: The deployment environment whose deployments count as production, as the code host names it, matched ignoring case.

failure_label.description: The label that marks an issue as a production failure.

production_branch.description: The branch production is deployed from. The repository's main branch if left out.

integration_branches.description: Branches that gather changes on their way to production, such as develop.

doc.description: The team's document, from the repository's root (R2).
